subject: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & reference rights (redlines)
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aurelia Simmons <aurelia@embertech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & reference rights (redlines)

Hi Aurelia —

Thanks again for a great call this morning. Per our discussion I've attached our redlines to the MSA and a proposed Order Form. The key outstanding items from EmberTech's side were around: (1) press release approval window, (2) logo/brand usage in marketing materials, and (3) customer reference rights for case studies.

High level changes you'll see in the MSA:
- Publicity: added a 10-business-day review for joint press releases and mutual approval language (we had suggested 5 days previously).
- Logo Use: added a limited non-exclusive licence for use on the Redwood website and partner materials; requires prior written approval for any co-branded materials beyond the website.
- References: we moved to a "reasonable efforts" clause for customer references and added an explicit opt-out path for sensitive product launch windows.

Please review and let me know if you prefer a redline call tomorrow morning. If easier, loop in your legal contact and we can triage line-by-line.

Attachments: Redline_MSA_EmberTech_20260218.docx; OrderForm_EmberTech_Proposed.pdf

Best,
Dev

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & reference rights (redlines)

Dev —

Thanks for sending the redlines. I shared with our legal and marketing teams; a few quick notes from product/marketing:
- Press release timing: EmberTech needs a 15-business-day review/cooling period for any quote that mentions our upcoming GA date. Can you confirm Redwood can accommodate that?
- Logo: marketing is ok with web use, but we can't allow use in any paid ad creative without an additional approval step.
- References: we'd prefer to keep reference requests limited to customer success outreach and limit technical deep-dives unless we sign off on a specific scope.

Looping Emily (marketing) and our legal alias. Robert from our PR agency may be involved for joint announcements; I'm copying him on the next thread if needed. Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow 10:30am PT to resolve outstanding bits.

Thanks,
Aurelia
Head of Partnerships | EmberTech
aurelia@embertech.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aurelia Simmons <aurelia@embertech.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:27:50 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & reference rights (redlines)

Hi Aurelia / team —

Thanks for the quick feedback. From a legal perspective a few clarifications on our redline choices:
1) Press release approval window: we proposed 10 business days as a balance; 15 days is acceptable but we'd ask that the clock starts on the date the draft is delivered in final form and that minor typographical edits do not trigger re-notice.
2) Logo use: we are fine to carve out "website and customer lists" and require an additional sign-off for paid advertising. We'll add the explicit line for paid creative.
3) References: the request to limit technical deep-dives is reasonable. We can add a two-step process: (a) CS-led reference requests for high-level business outcomes, (b) technical deep-dive requires a separate written consent and an identified subject matter owner.

Other open commercial items are noted in the Order Form (term, seats, committed throughput). Dev — please confirm that the Order Form quantities reflect EmberTech's expected start-of-production usage.

If everyone is agreeable I can prepare a version with the 15-day press release window and the paid-ad approval line included.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@embertech.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:18:10 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & reference rights (redlines)

Hi all —

From marketing's side we're comfortable with the 15-business-day review for any press release mentioning GA/launch milestones. Two asks: (1) we'd like a single point of contact at Redwood for approvals (to keep the clock moving), and (2) for logo use please include a short style guide attachment or link so we know how Redwood intends to present our mark.

Robert — I'll intro you to our in-house brand lead after this thread.

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
VP, Marketing | EmberTech

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & reference rights (redlines)

All —

Thanks for the confirmation and the asks. Quick summary & next steps so we have alignment:
- Press release review window: Redwood will accept 15 business days for GA-related press releases. Clock starts on receipt of final draft. Action: Laura to produce updated MSA clause with that timing.
- Logo use: Redwood will allow web and partner listings; paid ads require separate written approval. Action: Dev to share a short style guide link to EmberTech (see Drive link above).
- References: we will adopt the two-step reference process Laura proposed. Action: Monica (CS) to own reference outreach cadence.
- Order Form: EmberTech to confirm seat and throughput numbers by EOD Monday; Dev to lock final Order Form and circulate for signature.

I'll follow up with Laura's updated redline and the style guide link this afternoon. Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Dev
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
